title: Integrate new premium BunkPro logo assets across app branding

requirements.summary: Add new high-resolution BunkPro logo, horizontal wordmark, and favicon image assets per provided spec under the required generated assets paths.
acceptanceCriteria: New static image assets are added under frontend/public/assets/generated using the exact filenames specified in this build request’s imageRequirements.required entries.
The generated icon artwork remains clear when viewed at 48×48 and when visually cropped to a circle (no critical details cut off).
The wordmark clearly reads “BunkPro” with the requested gradient split between “Bunk” and “Pro” and a modern sans-serif look.
The background is dark navy and there is a visible soft glow under the emblem as part of the artwork in the provided exports.

file_operations.description: Add the new square app icon artwork export (dark navy background; circular purple-to-blue gradient ring; cap+checkmark+bar-graph; subtle 3D depth; soft glow), ensuring legibility at small sizes and safe circular crop.

Add the new horizontal logo/wordmark export (dark navy background; emblem + “Bunk” purple gradient and “Pro” blue gradient; modern sans-serif; subtle glow/shadow), ensuring the wordmark remains readable at typical UI sizes.
Add the new 32×32 favicon derived from the new icon artwork for browser tab usage.

requirements.summary: Update branding helpers so existing logo placements (Initial Loading Splash and Settings → About) automatically use the new generated logo assets without changing component logic.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/lib/branding.ts references the new generated logo filenames for getAppIcon(...) and getHorizontalLogo(...).
Initial loading splash screen displays the new logo without layout regressions (image loads, remains contained, and animations still run).
Settings → About displays the new horizontal/wordmark logo without breaking existing About content (app name, version text, and founder line remain).

file_operations.description: Update BRANDING.getAppIcon(...) to return /assets/generated/bunkpro-logo-icon.dim_4096x4096.png and BRANDING.getHorizontalLogo(...) to return /assets/generated/bunkpro-logo-horizontal.dim_4096x1536.png, using the same assets for light and dark themes (no separate variants provided).

requirements.summary: Point the browser favicon link to the newly generated BunkPro favicon asset.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html references the new favicon filename specified in imageRequirements.required.
After a hard refresh, the browser tab icon uses the new favicon (no reference to the previous bunkpro-uploaded-favicon.dim_32x32.png).

file_operations.description: Update the existing favicon <link> to reference /assets/generated/bunkpro-favicon.dim_32x32.png (replacing /assets/generated/bunkpro-uploaded-favicon.dim_32x32.png).
